plugins.name: bicep-avm-review
plugins.description: Reviews Bicep templates against Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and organisation conventions, and produces a traceable findings report.

skills.name: bicep-avm-review
skills.description: Review Azure Bicep templates and parameter files against Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and organisation IaC conventions, and produce a findings report with evidence. Use when the user asks to "review my Bicep", "check this against AVM", "is this template production ready", "audit our IaC", or opens a PR that changes *.bicep or *.bicepparam files. Do not use for Terraform, ARM JSON authoring, or for deploying resources.

agents.name: iac-reviewer
agents.description: Read-only reviewer for infrastructure-as-code pull requests.
